label: Service Provider
description: Providers of IT, network, hosting, digital and technical services in India.

label: Intermediary
description: Intermediary as defined under section 2(1)(w) of the Information Technology Act, 2000.

label: Data Centre
description: Entities providing data hosting, co-location, and compute infrastructure.

label: Virtual Private Server (VPS) Provider
description: Entities offering virtual private servers or slices to subscribers.

label: Cloud Service Provider
description: Entities providing IaaS, PaaS, SaaS or cloud services in Indian jurisdiction.

label: Virtual Private Network (VPN) Provider
description: Entities providing point-to-point and commercial VPN services.

label: Virtual Asset Service Provider
description: Entities providing virtual digital asset services as defined by Ministry of Finance.

label: Virtual Asset Exchange
description: Exchanges facilitating trading, exchange, and conversion of virtual digital assets.

label: Custodian Wallet Provider
description: Entities holding, safeguarding, or managing virtual digital assets on behalf of others.
